requirements.quote: I/We understand that, according to the general conditions of RFPs, offers must be secured with a bid security or to be supported with a Bid-Security Declaration.
requirements.text: Bidder must secure offers with a bid security or a Bid-Security Declaration.

requirements.quote: I/We undertake to stand to all our statements and declarations towards this RFP as agreed upon by us.
requirements.text: Bidder must adhere to all statements and declarations made in the RFP.

requirements.quote: I/we will not alter or change any of the conditions during the validity and after our selection as successful Technology Partner and award of this RFP.
requirements.text: Bidder must not alter conditions during validity or after selection.

requirements.quote: I/We will abide by all the terms and conditions of the RFP.
requirements.text: Bidder must abide by all RFP terms and conditions.

requirements.quote: I/we fully understand that I/we will be automatically disqualified and barred from bidding for any contract and doing business for a period of two (2) years upon receipt of your Barring/Blacklisting/Suspension Order.
requirements.text: Bidder will face disqualification and a two-year ban for violations.

requirements.quote: I/we will pay the applicable fine or damages as provided by any stipulation or guidelines from the appropriate authority in this regard for the violation of PoC Securing Declaration.
requirements.text: Bidder must pay fines or damages for violating the PoC Securing Declaration.

requirements.quote: I/We undertake to comply above, without prejudice to other legal action or remedies ITI Ltd. may have, to secure itself from the damages and losses incurred due to the act of default or violation by undersigned company/entity.
requirements.text: Bidder must comply with obligations and accept legal actions for defaults.
